core_obligations: Choose a representative (proof lines 4413-4422): the author replaces the object by a K-injective complex, so that both the derived pushforward and the global sections are computed naively.

Compare the two composites (proof lines 4422-4431): with that representative the composite RGamma(D, -) after Rf_* is computed by the sections over the site D of the direct image, which by the definition of the direct image agrees with the sections over C; the more general statement for V with U = u(V) is treated in the same way.
proof_roadmap: Replace the object by a K-injective complex so that both functors are explicit.
Compare the sections of the direct image over D with the sections over C.
Conclude both the global statement and the statement over an object V.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states the Leray identification for unbounded coefficients: the composite of the derived pushforward with global sections is the global sections functor on the source, and more generally sections over V are sections over u(V) after applying the derived pushforward (statement lines 4402-4411). The proof replaces the object by a K-injective complex so that both functors are computed naively (proof lines 4413-4422) and then compares the sections, using the definition of the direct image (proof lines 4422-4431), the case of an object V being the same computation. The non-formal content is the identification of the sections of the direct image. The claim is H2: one representative choice plus one comparison.
